# DATA PROCESSING ADDENDUM — Northwind Systems Ltd

This Addendum forms part of the Services Agreement between Northwind Systems
Ltd ("Supplier") and the customer named in the Order Form ("Customer").

## 1. Roles

1.1 Customer is the Controller. Supplier is the Processor.

## 2. Processing

2.1 Supplier shall Process Customer Personal Data only on Customer's
documented instructions.

2.2 Supplier shall not use Customer Personal Data for its own purposes.

## 3. Subprocessors

3.1 Supplier may engage Subprocessors listed in Schedule 2. Supplier shall
give Customer thirty (30) days' prior written notice of any intended change.

3.2 Customer may object to a change on reasonable data-protection grounds
within the notice period, and where the parties cannot agree an alternative,
Customer may terminate the affected Services without penalty.

## 4. Security

4.1 Supplier shall maintain ISO 27001 certification for the duration of the
Agreement and shall implement the measures described in Schedule 3.

## 5. Personal Data Breach

5.1 Supplier shall notify Customer without undue delay and in any event
within forty-eight (48) hours of becoming aware of a Personal Data Breach
affecting Customer Personal Data, and shall provide the information required
by Article 33(3) GDPR as it becomes available.

## 6. International Transfers

6.1 Transfers outside the UK or EEA shall be made under the applicable
Standard Contractual Clauses or the UK International Data Transfer Addendum.

## 7. Deletion

7.1 On termination Supplier shall delete or return Customer Personal Data
within sixty (60) days at Customer's election and certify deletion in
writing on request.
